description: How your hand position (relative to your shoulder, in units of your arm length) becomes the SO-ARM101 gripper tip position in its single vertical plane. forward/up are measured in your torso frame. If a recording has pick-protocol steps ('touch', 'grip'), the table height and the reach range are calibrated from them instead of the defaults below.

human.note: table_up: hand height when touching the table, as a fraction of arm length below the shoulder (seated). forward_range: nearest and farthest comfortable hand reach over the table.

robot.note: forward_range_m sits inside the simulated safe pick zone (17.5-24.5 cm for a 5 cm item). up_scale converts your hand height above the table into robot tip height (the robot arm is about 0.6x as long as a human arm). x_limits_m clamps the target to the safe zone so a long reach never asks the shoulder for more than ~40% of stall.

max_pitch_change_note: Per 20 ms frame (50 deg/s at most); larger jumps make the wrist spike past the motor cap.
